about: What a copy of the app made for others must not carry (tests/neutrality.test.mjs, scripts/neutrality.mjs). Another app reuses the test with its own copy of this file.

strings.why: Our own domain, in lower case as a host. The product name PrivateLocal.Chat is not a host and does not match.
The organisations that make the app. A copy is not branded by them.
A separate organisation whose hosts and products the app does not depend on (tests/no-tech-of-our-own.test.mjs checks the source).
The maintainer's account name; only the project's own repository is meant to carry it.
Hosts the app does not fetch models from: a model's files come from the configured source (docs/APP-CONFIG.md).
Analytics hosts. The app and its downloads carry none.
Links to the pages of our own site. The app reaches pages only through the site manifest (docs/SITE-LINKS.md).

allowed.why: The shipped default model source (assets.privatelocal.chat), written into index.html by the build from config/app-config.json; docs/APP-CONFIG.md says how to change it.
The shipped default model source, listed so that fetch-models can fetch from it.
The project's own repository (source, issues, releases), which every copy points to for the source it is built from.
A release's source pointer names the project's repository, the address of the source the folder was built from.
The vendored libraries' own text and defaults; the app configures them with its own sources, so these are never used.
The notices name the libraries' upstream projects and where their models are published.
The provider list: a service a person may choose to connect, not a source the app uses.

allowedHosts.why: The shipped default model source (see the allowed our-domain entry).
The shipped default model source, listed so that fetch-models can fetch from it.
This computer: the address the bundled server listens on and the instructions give.
Addresses in the text of the GNU General Public License.
The address a dataset's licence notice gives.
Addresses in the font licence text.
The author's address in a vendored library's licence.
